content_html:
watched #LittleHearts : A wholesome family entertainer that captures teenage love in a fun, light-hearted way. It’s sure to take you on a nostalgic trip back to your carefree college days, filled with laughter and feel-good moments!!!!

Kudos to Director and Writer Sai Marthand for presenting the story so realistically that you feel connected to every scene. As the movie went on, I was curious about how he would handle the climax, would he take the typical cinematic route of how they will convince their parents to accept their kids’ love or will he go completely off beat and if so, how would that fit into the film’s realistic and feel good tone? But hats off to him for delivering the climax in such a simple and honest way. It may feel a bit abrupt for regular moviegoers, but that’s exactly how life works 🙏

The lead pair of Mouli and Shivani Nagaram looked cute onscreen and they did a fantastic job, Its not only them all the Friends Gang along with seasoned Rajeev, Anitha, Kanchi, Satya did full justice to their roles.

Usually, teenage love stories are shown in two ways : one like Boyz or Bus Stop, filled with bold scenes and cuss words to attract youth, and the other like Bommarilu or Kotha Bangaru Lokam, which are more poetic and cinematic, aiming to be timeless classics. But here, the director chose a different path keeping it light-hearted and family-friendly, while still getting his message across and thats where I got totally impressed.

Having Said that, Not everyone may like it to watch on Big Screen as this movie doesn’t offer you any Cinematic Experience or Ultimate Content or Star Cast which would be a must watch on Big Screen….But you will never Regret it watching on Big Screen as you can some wonderful light hearted moments. 

If you are not willing to watch it on Big Screen, then you should not miss it on OTT. This movie could have been talk of the town on OTT but kudos to the team especially those who handled Promotions for releasing this among some medium movies and yet creating a buzz to create enough enthu to the audience to come and watch in theatres, but believe me you will not regret watching it on Big screen.
